checks.title: Review actual site and AdSense approval status, content and authorized seller information
evidence: Original useful site content and ownership verified
AdSense provider approval status observed or UNKNOWN
ads.txt entry from actual account and live root URL if used

checks.title: Inspect accidental-click risks and mobile tool UX before serving ads
evidence: Mobile and desktop evidence that ad slots cannot be mistaken for tool controls
Tool completion works with no-fill/ad-block and appropriate consent behavior
No automatic refresh, misleading labels or invalid traffic manipulation

checks.title: Review consent, privacy disclosure and source policy freshness
evidence: Google-certified CMP/TCF review for EEA, UK and Switzerland where applicable
Data processing disclosures and consent withdrawal verified

checks.title: Audit actual-versus-scenario revenue and cost metrics
evidence: Page views and estimated earnings from matching date windows, or UNKNOWN
Page RPM correctly calculated only from observed data
Cost/traffic scenarios clearly labeled and no income guarantees
